# Crazy SEO Team

> Crazy SEO Team is an SEO and digital growth website covering technical SEO, AI search optimization, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), LLM SEO, RAG knowledge retrieval readiness, content strategy and AI software services.

## Core service pages
- [Technical SEO](https://crazyseoteam.in/services/technical-seo): crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals and structured data.
- [On-Page SEO](https://crazyseoteam.in/services/on-page-seo): titles, meta descriptions, headings, content relevance, image alt text and internal links.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://crazyseoteam.in/services/geo-optimization): content clarity, entity context, source quality and discoverability in generative search.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://crazyseoteam.in/services/aeo-optimization): direct answers and supporting context for answer-oriented search experiences.
- [LLM SEO Optimization](https://crazyseoteam.in/services/llm-seo-optimization): semantic structure, entity consistency, source clarity and retrieval readiness for language-model-powered discovery.
- [RAG Optimization](https://crazyseoteam.in/services/rag-optimization): knowledge-base structure, document chunking, metadata, semantic retrieval and grounded-answer evaluation.
- [AI Visibility Audits](https://crazyseoteam.in/services/ai-visibility-audits): assess brand mentions, citations and content opportunities across AI search platforms.
- [Entity SEO](https://crazyseoteam.in/services/entity-seo): entity definitions, relationships and structured information.
- [Semantic SEO](https://crazyseoteam.in/services/semantic-seo): topic clusters, search intent, contextual coverage and internal linking.

## Definitions and limitations
- GEO concerns discoverability and references in generative search experiences. No provider can guarantee that an AI system will cite or recommend a brand.
- AEO focuses on clear answers and useful supporting context for answer engines.
- LLM SEO focuses on making information understandable, consistent and retrievable by language-model-powered systems. It does not guarantee inclusion in model training data.
- RAG optimization concerns external knowledge sources and retrieval pipelines used by RAG applications. It is not itself a Google ranking factor.
- Traditional technical SEO, useful content, accessibility, crawlability and trustworthy sources remain important foundations.
